detailed_description:
The target video is a warm, bright, romantic-comedy slice-of-life short with soft summer afternoon daylight, dappled leaf shadows on the path, gentle shallow depth of field, and a fresh, slightly luminous color grade.
[Shot 1] The shot opens on a medium tracking shot matching the composition of <Picture 3>: <Subject 1> rides a silver bicycle with a wire front basket along a tree-lined lakeside park path, both hands on the handlebars, pedaling easily with a relaxed smile. <Subject 2> sits on the rear rack behind him, both arms wrapped around his waist, her cheek resting lightly near his shoulder. Sunlight filters through the green canopy and flecks across the path. The bicycle rolls steadily forward. <Subject 2> (S1), in a young, sweet female voice with a teasing, amused tone, looks up at the side of <Subject 1>'s face and says, <d>[Chinese]你好油腻啊。</d> She then breaks into a playful grin and tightens her arms around his waist.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a medium close-up from the front three-quarter angle of <Subject 1> (S2), his hands still on the handlebars as the bicycle keeps rolling. He tilts his head, raises an eyebrow, and looks back over his shoulder with a cocky, amused expression, saying in a young, relaxed male voice with a hint of playful defiance, <d>[Chinese]怎么滴？你就不油腻啦？</d> The dappled light moves across his glasses and jacket.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.500, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 2> (S1) from the rear-rack angle, her arms still looped around <Subject 1>'s waist as her hair stirs lightly in the breeze. She scrunches her nose, gives a mock-exaggerated, coquettish sigh, and leans her cheek against his back, saying in a sweet, slightly whiny female voice, <d>[Chinese]那该怎么啊？那么油腻，好难受啊。</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts back to a two-shot composition echoing <Picture 3>, with the bicycle rolling forward along the lakeside path toward the depth of the tree tunnel. <Subject 1> (S2) glances back with a bright, self-assured grin, pats the handlebar lightly, and says in a bright, upbeat, slightly cocky tone, <d>[Chinese]简单用安仔的新版工作流就ok啦嘛。</d> <Subject 2> (S1) bursts into a laugh and buries her smile against his shoulder. The bicycle continues rolling gently away down the sun-dappled path as the frame softens on the two of them.
